history.summary: Newly-completed (2024) freehold 1BR at Myra, D13, 150m from Potong Pasir MRT, at $1.08M / $2,278 PSF — actually below the $2,425 URA median for the project. Best-in-class MRT proximity and a fresh FH building, but it is a small 474sqft shoebox and the appreciation rate carries new-launch bias.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $2,278 PSF is ~6% below the project's $2,425 URA median (69 transactions — a solid series), so it is priced attractively for Myra. The 2.6%/yr URA rate is flagged has_new_launch_bias=true, so don't trust it as resale appreciation. Brand-new FH directly beside Potong Pasir MRT is a genuine strength, but a 474sqft 1BR is the narrowest segment and Myra is a small development, capping liquidity. Net Neutral.
red_flags: Appreciation rate carries new-launch bias (true) — not reliable as forward resale rate
catalysts: 150m to Potong Pasir MRT (NE10) — among the closest in the batch
